title: The Relationship Between Exponentials and Logarithms
text:
The exponential function $y = a^x$ and the logarithmic function $y = \log_a(x)$ are inverses of each other.

This means:
- If $y = a^x$, then $x = \log_a(y)$
- The graphs are reflections of each other in the line $y = x$

title: Converting Between Forms
text:
Starting with $y = 2^x$:

1. Swap $x$ and $y$: $x = 2^y$
2. Solve for $y$ using logarithms: $y = \log_2(x)$

Therefore $f^{-1}(x) = \log_2(x)$
